description: This file contains test helper functions and type definitions for testing npm package installations and integrity checks within a TypeScript project using the Vitest testing framework.

classes.name: InstallResultLike
classes.description: Type representing the result of an installation attempt with a boolean 'ok' and an optional 'error' message.

classes.name: NpmPackMetadata
classes.description: Type representing metadata for an npm package, including id, name, version, filename, integrity, and shasum.

methods.name: export function createSuccessfulSpawnResult(stdout = ""): SpawnResult { createSuccessfulSpawnResult
methods.description: Creates a mock SpawnResult indicating a successful command execution with optional stdout content.

methods.name: export async function expectUnsupportedNpmSpec( expectUnsupportedNpmSpec
methods.description: Tests that an install function correctly handles unsupported npm specifications by asserting error containment.

methods.name: export function mockNpmPackMetadataResult( mockNpmPackMetadataResult
methods.description: Mocks the implementation of a spawn function to simulate npm pack command returning specified metadata.

methods.name: export function expectIntegrityDriftRejected(params: { expectIntegrityDriftRejected
methods.description: Asserts that an integrity drift detection correctly rejects mismatched integrity data and calls the appropriate handler.

methods.name: export async function expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts(params: { expectInstallUsesIgnoreScripts
methods.description: Tests that an npm install command uses the '--ignore-scripts' flag by mocking and verifying call parameters.
